name: Omni Sampler
author: MrHighMan
summary: Multi-format sampler: plays Akai, E-mu, Roland, Kontakt/Maschine, SF2 and SFZ instruments straight from their files or sampler disk images, with layers, keyswitching, a mod matrix and its own screen skin. Tested on MPC Live III with official MPC OS 3.10.1 and on MPC Live II with MPC OS 3.9.1 (Hakai).
